limitations: Existing evaluator and execution records were verified without rerunning submissions or the checker. Execution fields are recorded attestations, not independent sandbox or process-tree attestation.

Eligible-source equality uses the supplied source-hashes manifest and evaluator SKIP policy. Original workspaces, preregistration content, self-test output and identity maps were not read. Their supplied provenance digests were not independently regenerated.

Raw execution captures were not read. Their stored stdout digest and byte count match the reconstructed deterministic evaluator summary with Windows CRLF; stderr metadata declares the empty digest. Per-case output hashes are preserved as evaluator evidence.

Recorded solution-25 score 40 includes negative-case passes while its runtime excerpts report No module named ledgerreconcile. The score is copied unchanged from the actual evaluator output and does not establish a functioning CLI. Both accepted fields are false under strict 100/100.
